title: Spikes drive score negative and it wraps to 65136
observed: After collecting the coin at (1,3) (score 100) and then stepping onto spikes at (3,3) (-500), the score shows 65136 (65536-400), not 0. The score wraps around instead of clamping at 0.
expected: Score never goes below 0. Spikes subtract 500 but the score stops at 0, so it should read 0.
